title: manager setup · Assign planner to define a bounded research protocol for benchmarking
summary: Assign planner to define a bounded research protocol for benchmarking dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token constraints, adhering to strict stopping rules.
body: Prior cycles failed to find empirical data comparing dynamic memory consolidation against static baselines (e.g., append-only) under identical token budgets. Sources cited were descriptive or lacked controlled testing. The next task is to construct a specific, reproducible research plan targeting existing benchmarks that offer measurable metrics (task success, hallucination rates) under fixed resource constraints. The planner must define a hypothesis, select up to 4 sources that satisfy these constraints, and establish clear acceptance criteria for success or failure. If no such sources exist, the plan must be revised to match available evidence rather than forcing a fit. This phase is research-only; no code execution is permitted.
